caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table set against a plain, beige background with a thin rectangular border framing the image. The table has an oval-shaped top with a rich brown color and visible wood grain texture. It is supported by a single central pedestal leg, which is turned and shaped with multiple contours, and transitions into three curved legs that end in claw-like feet. The composition centers the table in the artwork, and shadows beneath the feet suggest a light source from above. The illustration uses varying shades of brown for the table and light tan for the background, with fine black outlines to define the structure and details of the table. There are hand-drawn inscriptions in the bottom left and right corners of the border.
title: Tilt-top Table
